definitions.explanation: The player who throws the ball to the batter in baseball. One of the most important defensive positions.

examples.japanese: {先発|せんぱつ}{投手|とうしゅ}が{7回|ななかい}を{無失点|むしってん}に{抑|おさ}えた。
examples.english: The starting pitcher held the opponents scoreless through seven innings.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{高校|こうこう}{時代|じだい}、エース{投手|とうしゅ}だった。
examples.english: He was the ace pitcher during high school.

examples.japanese: {投手|とうしゅ}{交代|こうたい}が{告|つ}げられた。

notes:
ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
・ピッチャー (pitcher - loanword, equally common)

TYPES OF PITCHERS:
・{先発|せんぱつ}{投手|とうしゅ} (starting pitcher)
・{中継|ちゅうけい}ぎ (relief pitcher, middle reliever)
・{抑|おさ}え/{クローザー} (closer)
・{敗戦|はいせん}{処理|しょり}{投手|とうしゅ} (mop-up pitcher)

KEY STATISTICS:
・{防御率|ぼうぎょりつ} (ERA - earned run average)
・{奪三振|だつさんしん} (strikeouts)
・{勝利|しょうり}{投手|とうしゅ} (winning pitcher)
・{敗戦|はいせん}{投手|とうしゅ} (losing pitcher)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{投手|とうしゅ}を{交代|こうたい}する (to change pitchers)
・{投手|とうしゅ}が{崩|くず}れる (pitcher falls apart/loses effectiveness)
・{投手|とうしゅ}{陣|じん} (pitching staff)
・エース{投手|とうしゅ} (ace pitcher)
